name: Anachey Strawberries
tagline: This Texas Farm Has Been Growing Strawberries Since Before Spring Was a City – TX Headlines
description: Anachey Strawberries is an agritourism farm in 189 Schuettig Rd, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
